selfServe.name: Census County boundaries (2010)

selfServe.license: US federal public domain; redistribution allowed. Credit the US Census Bureau (TIGER/Line Shapefiles).

files.name: county_boundaries_v1.tar.gz
files.note: MANIFEST.txt inside; sha256 and size in the spacescans data manifest (SHA256SUMS.txt in the OneDrive folder)

notes: Prefer the original source? tl_2010_us_county10.zip (the single NATIONAL file) from https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2010/COUNTY/2010/ — unzip into County/C3/tl_2010_us_county10/.

selfServe.name: KNMI TEMIS UV — daily UV index / dose (2013–2019)
selfServe.sourceName: KNMI / ESA, Tropospheric Emission Monitoring Internet Service (TEMIS)
selfServe.license: Free use with credits; redistribution not granted: neither the raw HDF files nor the converted parquet may be redistributed. Credit KNMI/ESA TEMIS (https://www.temis.nl/).

files.name: {var}YYYYMMDD.hdf
files.note: 4 variables (uvief, uvdec, uvdvc, uvddc) — one file per day

notes: No census boundary file needed — values are linked straight from each patient's 270 m residential buffer onto this raster grid (grid_weights), not via block-group polygons.
Native HDF-4 — install pyhdf (+ the system HDF4 library) to read it.

Scriptable: `spacescans data fetch --dataset temis_uv_raw --accept-terms knmi-temis` downloads every day from the CloudFront mirror d1qb6yzwaaq4he.cloudfront.net/uvradiation/v2.0/{year}/{mm}/{var}YYYYMMDD.hdf
Layout: one subfolder per variable, then per year.
The first run auto-converts the HDF archive to compact parquet (one-time, ~2 min); every later run reads parquet in seconds. No manual step needed.

Data © KNMI/ESA (https://www.temis.nl/), used with credits; neither the raw HDFs nor the converted parquet are redistributed with this repo — each deployment downloads its own copy and converts locally.

selfServe.name: ACAG PM2.5 composition — V5.NA.05 biweekly (2013–2019)
selfServe.sourceName: Atmospheric Composition Analysis Group (ACAG), Washington University in St. Louis
selfServe.license: Not stated for the North American V5.NA.05 product; ACAG states CC BY 4.0 for its global product only; redistribution not confirmed for this product: do not redistribute until ACAG confirms the licence. Cite the van Donkelaar et al. paper that the ACAG dataset page lists for V5.NA.05 / V5.NA.05.02.

files.name: V5NA05.HybridPM25[.FromBiomass].xNorthAmerica.YYYYDDD-YYYYDDD.nc
files.note: total PM2.5, 26 biweekly files per year

files.name: V5NA05.02.Hybrid<SP>-<SP>[.FromBiomass].xNorthAmerica.YYYYDDD-YYYYDDD.nc
files.note: seven components: BC, DUST, NH4, NO3, OM, SO4, SS

notes: No census boundary file needed — values are linked straight from each patient's 270 m residential buffer onto the 0.01° grid (grid_weights); the template raster ACAG/C3/acag_template.tif ships with the repo.
Both variants are required: the linkage derives each species' non-biomass share as plain minus FromBiomass.

Scriptable: `spacescans data fetch --dataset acag --accept-terms acag-v5na05` fetches the files one by one from the four WashU Box shares (the folder API rejects anonymous calls and 'download folder' is disabled); pipeline-data/ACAG/README.md documents the folder IDs.
{dir} is PM25, BC, DUST, NH4, NO3, OM, SO4, SS for the plain surfaces and the same names with _bm for the FromBiomass ones.
Years 2000–2023 are available upstream; 2013–2019 matches the app's other gridded sources.

files.note: one per year; download the .txt.gz and gunzip

notes: Needs the 2010 Census Tract boundaries (TRACT/C3) — the same tract weight table Food Access uses, and a cohort that has run either gets the other's rasterization from cache.

Scriptable: `spacescans data fetch --dataset faqsd --accept-terms epa-faqsd`, or by hand from https://ofmpub.epa.gov/rsig/rsigserver?data/FAQSD/outputs/{year}_{pm25_daily_average|ozone_daily_8hour_maximum}.txt.gz

EPA switched header styles between years (FIPS/value vs Loc_Label1/Prediction, and two date formats); the reader takes columns by position and parses both date styles, so keep the files exactly as published.

preset.name: Neighborhood Deprivation Index (NDI)
preset.origin: Built from Census ACS 5-year via an xgboost model — no public download.

preset.name: Community Organization Density (ZBP + county CBP)
preset.origin: Derived from Census ZIP + County Business Patterns (raw ZBP/CBP are public). ZBP gives ZCTA5-level density; patients whose ZIP has no ZBP row fall back to their county's CBP — so BOTH files are needed. The fallback also reuses the ZBP linkage output internally (auto-generated per run, not a download).

preset.name: EPA Walkability Index
preset.origin: Converted from the EPA Smart Location Database (raw SLD is public). The pipeline uses the 2016 year as a static index; the file's 2021 rows are filtered out.

preset.name: USDA Food Access (FARA)
preset.origin: Interpolated from USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas (raw FARA is public).
preset.downloadNote: fara_nationwide_2010_2019_interpolated.Rda (448 MB) from the project's OneDrive folder (the same one as the boundary archives); drop it in FARA/C4/. US federal public domain (derived). Credit the USDA Economic Research Service (Food Access Research Atlas).
